feature_definitions.extrapolation: target size divided by largest probe size
feature_definitions.implementation_throughput_penalty: work compression divided by observed audit/verify wall ratio
feature_definitions.native_floor: fixed 0.5 ms divided by extrapolated native target time
feature_definitions.repeatability: maximum tolerance-normalized deviation over repeated native executions
feature_definitions.scaling_curvature: max absolute difference between adjacent log-log exponents over three preflight sizes
feature_definitions.witness_extractability: incremental candidate/native time at largest probe
feature_definitions.work_compression: registered independent audit work divided by verifier work
